:::{#prp-angle-unit-circle-range}
#### Range of an angle on the unit circle

An [angle](#def-angle-unit-circle) between two points of the [unit circle](#def-unit-circle)
is at least $0$, at most $\pi$ (@def-pi).

:::

::: proof

The whole circle has length $2\pi$ (@def-pi).
Going the short way round covers at most half of the circle, which is $\pi$.
A distance along the circle is at least $0$.

:::
